> Integration after kernel slices #44817, #44818, #44819, #44820, #44821, #44822. Review the last 4 commits: `6df63d7ce6`, `1a1be676eb`, `0711869f48`, `13db6c0571` (642 lines). Compare: https://github.com/yuychang/sglang/compare/up/b5f-latent-tail-adapter...up/b5-fp8-moe-front-tail


## AITER prerequisites

None. This kernel is compiled from the SGLang tree. It only imports AITER FlyDSL helpers that are already on AITER main. [ROCm/aiter#6026](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6026) is not used: the measured recipe compiles the vendored kernel (`SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_FLYDSL_SOURCE=sglang`).

## Motivation

Before routing, Kimi-K3 runs three projections on the same hidden state: the router, the latent down projection and the shared expert. After the experts it runs a residual add, RMSNorm and the latent up projection. At small decode batches each is a separate small launch.

## Modifications

Kernel slices: #44817, #44818, #44819, #44820, #44821, #44822.

**`6df63d7ce6` add QuarkW4A4MXFP4.materialize_bf16_weight**
- Return a dense BF16 copy of an MXFP4 dense linear's weight without changing the layer.
- Let models build their own decode-side weight caches from Quark MXFP4 linears.

**`1a1be676eb` run the ROCm MoE front through the FP8 pre-route and latent tail kernels**
- Add forward_fused_rocm, the ROCm counterpart of the fused [latent | shared] MoE path, in kimi_k3_rocm_moe.py.
- Merge only the router and latent projections when Quark leaves the shared experts quantized.
- Build FP8 pre-route weights from Quark MXFP4 shared experts through materialize_bf16_weight.
- Run the router, latent down and shared gate-up as one FP8 launch for 1 to 4 tokens, and the shared down as another.
- Fuse the latent RMSNorm, up-projection and residual add for 1, 2 or 4 tokens.
- Run the quantized shared down-projection through its own kernel when the activated input skips the FP8 path.
- Gate it behind SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_MOE_PREROUTE_FP8 and SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_LATENT_TAIL_FP8, off by default.
- Document the switches.

**`0711869f48` drop a per-layer bias cast and the MoE output scratch on ROCm**
- Store the MoE correction bias in the gate-logit dtype at load when AITER routes, so topk stops casting it every call.
- Write the final MoE three-way add into the up-projection output on ROCm instead of a fresh [M, D] tensor.
- Neither changes the computed values.

**`13db6c0571` make the ROCm latent MoE tail token count a runtime argument and use it in speculative verify**
- Make the token count a runtime argument of the latent-tail kernel, with token tiles of 1, 2, 4 and 8, up to 256.
- Use the fused tail for decode and verify batches up to SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_LATENT_TAIL_MAX_TOKENS, default 4.
- Default to 4 because 32 served slower on MI355X: 8K/1K at 8-32 requests, DSpark AgentX at 4 and 48.
- Reject a ceiling outside the kernel range at load instead of clamping it.
- Test every token tile with a residual prefix and document the ceiling.

Switch: `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_MOE_PREROUTE_FP8`, `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_PREROUTE_PREACTIVATED_SHARED`, `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_LATENT_TAIL_FP8` (ceiling `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_LATENT_TAIL_MAX_TOKENS=4`). Everything is ROCm only; CUDA and other checkpoints keep the existing path.

Each FlyDSL kernel builder stays one function, because it is one kernel construction.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, 5-shot, 1319 questions, same server as the speed test:

| Base (flags off) | This PR (flags on) |
|---:|---:|
| 0.951 | 0.941 |

GSM8K varies by about 0.01 between runs of the same serving code on this setup (0.922 to 0.943 over repeats of one branch), so a difference of that size is noise.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MI355X x8, TP8, `/data/models/Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, sgl-project `main` at `d2a436446c` plus this stack. AITER: [`yuychang/aiter@9e60d76d1`](https://github.com/yuychang/aiter/tree/k3/pr-stack-bench-20261014), ROCm/aiter `main` at `a1e5a4616` plus the drafts named under AITER prerequisites. +# Copyright (c) 2025 FlyDSL Project Contributors
+# Modifications Copyright (C) 2026 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
+
+"""Vendored FlyDSL vector wrappers for the Kimi-K3 FlyDSL kernels.
+
+Re-exports the raw dialect, unwraps DSL values, and fills dynamic-index
+sentinels. FlyDSL removed ``flydsl.expr.vector`` before ROCm/FlyDSL#880 and
+AITER no longer ships a copy, so SGLang keeps this one. Remove it once the
+callers use the raw dialect or the typed vector API.
+Source: FlyDSL ``python/flydsl/expr/vector.py``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from flydsl._mlir import ir
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects import vector as _vector
+
+# Re-export the raw dialect so vector.broadcast / vector.shuffle work directly
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects.vector import *
+from flydsl.expr.meta import dsl_loc_tracing
+
+# Vector and related types, which flydsl.expr.vector also re-exported
+from flydsl.expr.typing import (  # noqa: F401
+    ReductionOp,
+    Vector,
+    as_ir_value,
+    empty_like,
+    full,
+    full_like,
+    ones_like,
+    zeros_like,
+)
+
+# Dialect helper wrappers. Prefer Vector methods or the raw dialect.
+
+
+def _as_index_ir_value(value):
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        from flydsl.expr import arith as _arith_ext
+
+        return _arith_ext.constant(value, index=True)
+    v = as_ir_value(value)
+    # vector/memref indices must be index-typed; cast integer offsets
+    # (e.g. fx.Int64/i32) so callers can pass explicit-width offsets.
+    if isinstance(v.type, ir.IntegerType):
+        from flydsl._mlir.dialects import arith as _std_arith
+
+        v = _std_arith.IndexCastOp(ir.IndexType.get(), v).result
+    return v
+
+
+@dsl_loc_tracing
+def from_elements(*args, **kwargs):
+    """Build a vector from scalars, unwrapping DSL values."""
+    if len(args) >= 2:
+        args = list(args)
+        elems = args[1]
+        if isinstance(elems, (list, tuple)):
+            args[1] = [as_ir_value(v) for v in elems]
+        return _vector.from_elements(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    return _vector.from_elements(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+@dsl_loc_tracing
+def store(value, memref, indices, **kwargs):
+    """Store a vector, unwrapping DSL values and converting indices."""
+    return _vector.store(
+        as_ir_value(value),
+        as_ir_value(memref),
+        [_as_index_ir_value(i) for i in indices],
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Thin wrappers for common op classes that otherwise require `.result` access.
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@dsl_loc_tracing
+def extract(vector, static_position=None, dynamic_position=None):
+    """Extract vector elements, filling missing dynamic-index sentinels."""
+    if static_position is None:
+        static_position = []
+    if dynamic_position is None:
+        dynamic_position = []
+    dynamic_position = [_as_index_ir_value(i) for i in dynamic_position]
+
+    n_static = len(static_position)
+    n_dynamic = len(dynamic_position)
+    if n_dynamic > 0 and n_static < n_dynamic:
+        kDynamic = ir.ShapedType.get_dynamic_size()
+        static_position = list(static_position) + [kDynamic] * (n_dynamic - n_static)
+
+    return _vector.ExtractOp(
+        as_ir_value(vector),
+        static_position=static_position,
+        dynamic_position=dynamic_position,
+    ).result
+
+
+@dsl_loc_tracing
+def load_op(result_type, memref, indices):
+    """Load a vector, unwrapping DSL values and converting indices."""
+    return _vector.LoadOp(
+        result_type,
+        as_ir_value(memref),
+        [_as_index_ir_value(i) for i in indices],
+    ).result
+
+
+@dsl_loc_tracing
+def bitcast(result_type, source):

+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.tensor_shim import (

+    AITER_FLYDSL_KERNARG_PRELOAD_COUNT,

+_SHARED_GATE_UP_SIZE = 2 * _SHARED_INTERMEDIATE_SIZE
+_HIDDEN_SIZE = 7168
+_WAVE_SIZE = 64
+_ELEMENTS_PER_LOAD = 4
+
+
+def _find_ocml_bitcode() -> str:
+    """Find ROCm's device math library without pinning a ROCm release."""
+
+    roots = [
+        Path(value)
+        for value in (
+            os.environ.get("ROCM_PATH"),
+            os.environ.get("ROCM_HOME"),
+            "/opt/rocm",
+        )
+        if value
+    ]
+    patterns = (
+        "amdgcn/bitcode/ocml.bc",
+        "lib/llvm/lib/clang/*/lib/amdgcn/bitcode/ocml.bc",
+    )
+    for root in roots:
+        for pattern in patterns:
+            matches = sorted(root.glob(pattern), reverse=True)
+            if matches:
+                return str(matches[0])
+    raise RuntimeError("unable to locate ROCm OCML bitcode")
+
+
+def _raw(value):
+    try:
+        return value.ir_value()
+    except AttributeError:
+        return value
+
+
+def build_kimi_k3_b1_shared_down_fp8_module(
+    num_tokens: int = 1,
+    rows_per_wave: int = 2,
+    cu_count: int = 256,
+    waves_per_eu: int = 0,
+    weight_cache_modifier: int = 2,
+    situ_beta: float = 4.0,
+    situ_linear_beta: float = 25.0,
+):

+
+    if num_tokens != 1:
+        raise ValueError("num_tokens must be 1")
+    if rows_per_wave not in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8):
+        raise ValueError("rows_per_wave must be 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, or 8")
+    if not 1 <= cu_count <= 256:
+        raise ValueError("cu_count must be between 1 and 256")
+    if waves_per_eu < 0:
+        raise ValueError("waves_per_eu must be non-negative")
+    if weight_cache_modifier not in (0, 1, 2, 3):
+        raise ValueError("weight_cache_modifier must be between 0 and 3")

+        not math.isfinite(situ_beta)
+        or not math.isfinite(situ_linear_beta)
+        or situ_beta <= 0.0
+        or situ_linear_beta <= 0.0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("SiTU beta values must be finite and positive")

+    block_threads = waves_per_block * _WAVE_SIZE
+    groups_per_grid = cu_count * waves_per_block
+    persistent_iterations = (output_groups + groups_per_grid - 1) // groups_per_grid

+        "__ocml_exp_f32",

+        "float32",
+        is_pure=True,

+    linear_beta_tag = f"{situ_linear_beta:g}".replace(".", "p")

+        f"_rpw{rows_per_wave}_cu{cu_count}_wpb{waves_per_block}"
+        f"_wpe{waves_per_eu}_wcm{weight_cache_modifier}"

+    )

+        name=kernel_name,
+        known_block_size=[block_threads, 1, 1],
+    )

+        weight: fx.Pointer,
+        weight_scale: fx.Pointer,

+        wave = tid // arith.constant(_WAVE_SIZE, type=i32)

+        weight_rsrc = ptr_rsrc(weight)
+        scale_rsrc = ptr_rsrc(weight_scale)
+        output_rsrc = ptr_rsrc(output)
+        token = ArithValue(gpu.block_idx.y)
+        gate_up_token_base = token * arith.constant(

+        )

+        )
+

+        vec4_bf16 = T.vec(_ELEMENTS_PER_LOAD, T.bf16)
+        vec4_f32 = T.vec(_ELEMENTS_PER_LOAD, f32)
+        zero_f32 = arith.constant(0.0, type=f32)
+        one_f32 = arith.constant(1.0, type=f32)
+        zero_i32 = arith.constant(0, type=i32)

+            # Match vLLM's production 1 / (1 + expf(-x)) evaluation.
+            exponent = ocml_exp_f32(-value)

+            packed = buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                resource,
+                element_index // arith.constant(4, type=i32),
+                vec_width=1,
+                dtype=i32,
+                cache_modifier=weight_cache_modifier,
+            )

+                res=vec2_f32,
+                src=packed,
+                word_sel=False,

+        for activation_iteration in range_constexpr(
+            (_SHARED_INTERMEDIATE_SIZE + block_threads - 1) // block_threads

+                activation_iteration * block_threads, type=i32

+                    gate_up_rsrc,
+                    gate_up_token_base

+                    + arith.constant(_SHARED_INTERMEDIATE_SIZE, type=i32),
+                    vec_width=1,
+                    dtype=T.bf16,
+                )

+                up = ArithValue(arith.extf(f32, up_bf16))
+                beta = arith.constant(float(situ_beta), type=f32)
+                inv_beta = arith.constant(1.0 / float(situ_beta), type=f32)
+                linear_beta = arith.constant(float(situ_linear_beta), type=f32)
+                inv_linear_beta = arith.constant(
+                    1.0 / float(situ_linear_beta),
+                    type=f32,
+                )
+                activated = (
+                    beta
+                    * tanh(gate * inv_beta)
+                    * sigmoid(gate)
+                    * linear_beta
+                    * tanh(up * inv_linear_beta)
+                )
+                fx.ptr_store(
+                    arith.trunc_f(T.bf16, _raw(activated)),
+                    activated_lds + element,
+                )
+                scf.YieldOp([])

+
+        first_group = (
+            ArithValue(gpu.block_idx.x) * arith.constant(waves_per_block, type=i32)
+            + wave
+        )
+        for persistent_index in range_constexpr(persistent_iterations):
+            group = first_group + arith.constant(
+                persistent_index * groups_per_grid,
+                type=i32,
+            )
+            row_base = group * arith.constant(rows_per_wave, type=i32)
+            for row_offset in range_constexpr(rows_per_wave):
+                row = row_base + arith.constant(row_offset, type=i32)
+                row_in_range = arith.cmpi(
+                    CmpIPredicate.ult,
+                    row,
+                    arith.constant(_HIDDEN_SIZE, type=i32),
+                )
+                row_if = scf.IfOp(row_in_range)
+                with ir.InsertionPoint(row_if.then_block):
+                    row_scale = buffer_ops.buffer_load(
+                        scale_rsrc,
+                        row,
+                        vec_width=1,
+                        dtype=f32,
+                    )
+                    local_dot = ArithValue(zero_f32)
+                    for k_iteration in range_constexpr(
+                        _SHARED_INTERMEDIATE_SIZE // (_WAVE_SIZE * _ELEMENTS_PER_LOAD)
+                    ):
+                        k_element = (
+                            lane + arith.constant(k_iteration * _WAVE_SIZE, type=i32)
+                        ) * arith.constant(_ELEMENTS_PER_LOAD, type=i32)
+                        activated_bf16 = fx.ptr_load(
+                            activated_lds + k_element,
+                            result_type=vec4_bf16,
+                        )
+                        activated_f32 = ArithValue(activated_bf16).extf(vec4_f32)

+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch_shared_down_fp8(

+"""Graph microbenchmark for the Kimi-K3 FP8 pre-route projections on gfx950.
+
+Run: python test/manual/kernels/bench_kimi_k3_moe_preroute_fp8.py --tokens 1
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import statistics
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.kimi_k3_flydsl.kimi_k3_moe_preroute_fp8 import (
+    kimi_k3_moe_tri_projection_cooperative_preactivated_fp8,
+    kimi_k3_moe_tri_projection_fp8,
+    quantize_preroute_weight,
+)
+
+# Each FP8 weight set is ~50 MB; eight of them exceed MI355X's 256 MB MALL, so
+# every replay reads its weights from HBM as decode does.
+_NUM_WEIGHT_SETS = 8
+
+
+def bench(fns, warmup: int, iters: int, trials: int) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
+    """p50/p10/p90 microseconds per call; one graph replays every fn once."""
+    for fn in fns:
+        fn()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        for fn in fns:
+            fn()
+    for _ in range(warmup):
+        graph.replay()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    samples = []
+    for _ in range(trials):
+        start = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        start.record()
+        for _ in range(iters):
+            graph.replay()
+        end.record()
+        end.synchronize()
+        samples.append(start.elapsed_time(end) * 1000 / (iters * len(fns)))
+    ordered = sorted(samples)
+    return (
+        statistics.median(samples),
+        ordered[max(0, trials // 10 - 1)],
+        ordered[min(trials - 1, 9 * trials // 10)],
+    )
+
+
+def _weight_set(tokens: int, device: torch.device):
+    routed_bf16 = torch.randn((3584, 7168), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    shared_bf16 = torch.randn((1536, 7168), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    router = torch.randn((896, 7168), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    routed, routed_scale = quantize_preroute_weight(routed_bf16)
+    shared, shared_scale = quantize_preroute_weight(shared_bf16)
+    if tokens in (2, 4):
+        # The cooperative kernel reads gate and up rows interleaved.
+        shared = (
+            shared.view(2, 768, 7168).permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous().view(1536, 7168)
+        )
+        shared_scale = shared_scale.view(2, 768).t().contiguous().view(1536)
+    merged = torch.cat((shared_bf16, router, routed_bf16), dim=0).contiguous()
+    return (routed, routed_scale, shared, shared_scale, router), merged
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--tokens", type=int, choices=(1, 2, 4), required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=20)
+    parser.add_argument("--iters", type=int, default=100)
+    parser.add_argument("--trials", type=int, default=11)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    torch.manual_seed(20260817)
+    device = torch.device("cuda")
+    hidden = torch.randn((args.tokens, 7168), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    sets = [_weight_set(args.tokens, device) for _ in range(_NUM_WEIGHT_SETS)]

+        f"speedup={bf16[0] / fp8[0]:.3f}x"
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
